references.text: The description of the holy garments to be made for Aaron and his sons for priestly service, including the breastpiece, ephod, robe, and other vestments.
Mentions the ministerial garments and the holy clothes for the priest Aaron and the garments for his sons when they perform priestly duties.
The fulfillment of the command to make the ministerial garments from blue, purple, and scarlet wool for service in the sanctuary.
Describes the finished ministerial garments for service in the sanctuary and the holy clothes for the priest Aaron and his sons.
Moses dresses Aaron in the holy priestly garments at the consecration, including the tunic, sash, robe, ephod, and breastpiece.
Refers to the use of blue fabric and other textiles in connection with service in the sanctuary.
Lists the specific garments that make up 'the holy garments' mentioned in the source verse.
Expands on the theme by showing the role of the garments in the succession of the priesthood.
Describes the use of the garments in the consecration ritual that makes priestly service possible.
